comment: Blood Sun step 4, R1 (design §11): a Lotus Vale PLAYED with fewer than two untapped lands goes to the graveyard (its replacement fails) -- but it WAS played (CR 305.1: playing a land is the special action; the drop is spent, CR 305.2), so Fastbond's trigger (ruling 1: 'You take damage when you play a land using the play a land action') fires for it as the second land: 20 -> 19.
